summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue with array handling in patching but may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch changes the logic for determining the number of mock patch arguments, which could potentially affect other use cases of patching. There is a risk of introducing behavioral regressions.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify that the change does not break other functionalities related to patching. More comprehensive tests are needed to ensure the fix is robust.
